ops.text: drive verbs run on a Sprite relay to the coordinator's Mac through Orca questions, and on job j6496 four of them (handoff READ relay_4bb6ae6ae55e, drive status relay_a148ebc50d82, drive pr add relay_fb5f10f9ad1e, drive job set --repro relay_737463bcc9c0) sat unanswered past the 9-minute verb timeout; two later landed as late status mail ('drive exited 0'), so the verb reports failure while the Mac may still run it, and the handoff file the brief says to read whole never arrived. A relay that outlives its verb should either keep the verb waiting until the answer or hand back a resumable id the verb itself can await.
